455743.overview: Spacefire is a shooting game in space. Space ships erratically fly across the screen. They start out small (far away) and get bigger the longer they are in view. The player can fire from a first person perspective but must time the shots whenever the ship passes by the crosshair in the center of the screen. Points are awarded based on how far away the ship still was. The game ends when a ship comes too close. There are three game modes with different game speeds.

455744.overview: Submarine is a Depthcharge variant. The player controls a warship and can drop depth charges into the sea. Submarines are seen below the surface in a side-view. The aim is to hit the submarines. The submarines also fire torpedoes up towards the player so those must be dodged. The game can be played with one or two players in two different levels.
